title: Add lichen_link_channel_select_sync() GNSS path
description: Implement the CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP guarded lichen_link_channel_select_sync() in link_ctx.c that uses lichen_hal_time_snapshot_get() for GNSS-valid time, calls lichen_sfn_from_unix_ms() and lichen_sync_hop_channel(). ~15 lines in 1 file. Depends on HAL time API existing.
